question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the **significant role of human beings in using and creating resources and environments.**
 
• The appropriate verb should fit well with the context of** utilizing or making use of resources.**
 
• "**Utilised**" fits well as it denotes the act of making practical and effective use of something.
 
• Other options ("**broken**", "**crippled**", "**destroyed**") do not fit the context of the constructive role humans play.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
